item.title: 'I have best numbers ever': Donald Trump ‘would love’ to run for third presidential term — Can he really make it happen?
item.description: Donald Trump has ruled out a 2028 vice presidential run, but not a third presidential term, sparking speculation. While constitutional scholars deem a third term legally impossible under the 22nd Amendment, some allies suggest "creative" workarounds. Trump himself expressed a desire to serve again, citing strong poll numbers, leaving the door ajar for future possibilities.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: SNAP benefits to end on November 1; air traffic controllers to miss first paychecks — will Trump and Democrats strike a deal to end shutdown?
item.description: Millions of Americans face food assistance cuts as the US government shutdown enters its fourth week. Air traffic controllers are preparing to miss their first paychecks, leading to widespread flight delays. While Medicare and Medicaid are currently unaffected, prolonged gridlock could strain healthcare providers.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Influencer Ben Bader dies suddenly at 25 after posting final TikTok hours before death
item.description: Beloved finance and lifestyle influencer Ben Bader, 25, has passed away unexpectedly on October 23. His girlfriend confirmed his sudden death, stating there were no prior signs of illness. Bader, who amassed over 200,000 followers, was active online just hours before his passing. Friends and fellow creators are mourning the loss of the positive content creator.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Influencer Molly Blutstein’s Brooklyn apartment sparks huge debate after Architectural Digest feature leaves internet completely divided
item.description: Influencer Molly Blutstein's Brooklyn apartment, featured in Architectural Digest, has sparked widespread online criticism. While she aimed to showcase her unique 'Southern Gothic' style with antique pieces, many netizens deemed the space 'unfinished' and questioned the magazine's choice. Supporters, however, defend her personal taste, shifting blame to AD's editorial decisions.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: How Ray Asian Boy’s random 7-Eleven meeting with Kai Cenat turned into a global streaming empire
item.description: Taiwanese streamer Ray Asian Boy's career skyrocketed after a chance 2023 encounter with Kai Cenat in Tokyo. His authentic humor propelled him to millions of followers on TikTok and Twitch. After a mental health break in 2025, he's now teasing an Adidas collaboration, showcasing a significant career evolution from a viral moment to global recognition.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: YouTuber Anders Otteson leaks bombshell footage of mystery UFO-like aircraft tested at US Skunk Works weapons base
item.description: Investigative YouTuber Anders Otteson claims to have filmed a mysterious, wing-shaped aircraft undergoing testing at Lockheed Martin's secretive Skunk Works facility in California. The footage, captured from public land near a radar-testing site, shows the object floating and rotating, sparking speculation about advanced drone or stealth technology development. This sighting adds to ongoing public intrigue surrounding classified military projects.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Who is Clix and How he bought $530k house at the age of 17 after being kicked by parents
item.description: At just 17, American Fortnite star Clix shocked many by purchasing a $530,000 house, a feat achieved after being kicked out by his parents during his early gaming days. He proved his critics wrong by earning substantial income from tournaments, streaming, and sponsorships, solidifying his status as a top Twitch streamer and entrepreneur.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Mizkif explodes at viewers during livestream over Emiru comments as abuse allegations resurface online
item.description: Twitch streamer Mizkif faced significant backlash after old clips resurfaced showing him aggressively reacting to viewers mentioning his ex-partner, Emiru, who recently accused him of controlling behavior. In the viral clips, Mizkif lashed out at fans, calling them 'losers' and banning them, while also defending his career despite declining viewership.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Who is Cinna? Meet FaZe Clan’s first female member making history
item.description: Esports giant FaZe Clan has made history by signing its first female member, content creator Cinna. This groundbreaking move, celebrated by fans, signifies a significant step towards diversity and inclusion in competitive gaming. Cinna, known for her engaging personality and relatable content, aims to inspire aspiring female gamers, marking a new era for the organization and the industry.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Smallville star Allison Mack to speak publicly for the first time about NXIVM s*x cult in new CBC podcast series
item.description: Former Smallville actress Allison Mack, a former NXIVM leader, is breaking her silence in a new podcast. After serving 21 months for her role in the sex cult, Mack will detail her involvement, recruitment of women, and life post-prison. The podcast promises to explore her journey into and out of the organization.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Why QTCinderella is facing massive backlash? The viral Twitch stream controversy over racism, homophobia and friendship explained
item.description: Popular streamer QTCinderella is facing significant backlash after defending friendships with individuals accused of racism and homophobia. Her comments, suggesting kindness to a hateful person doesn't equate to agreement, ignited a fierce online debate. While some defended her, others accused her of enabling harmful behavior, leading to a fellow streamer distancing herself.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: IShowSpeed goes viral again after reviving his “my mom is kinda homeless” meme moment
item.description: Streamer IShowSpeed has brought back his famous "my mom is kinda homeless" meme. He recently recreated the viral moment during a live broadcast. This has reignited online conversations and meme creation. Fans are comparing the new stream to the original. The event highlights the lasting impact of spontaneous online content.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Top doctor reveals why Trump suddenly got an MRI scan: 'Undisclosed medical problems...'
item.description: A top cardiologist suggests President Trump's MRI was prompted by symptoms, not routine checks, as MRIs require a clear medical reason. Concerns about Trump's health have risen due to visible bruising and gait issues, potentially linked to blood-thinning medication for cardiovascular conditions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: What is the Dunki route? 50 Haryana men deported from US after chasing a Shah Rukh Khan-style dream
item.description: Dozens of young men from Haryana, aged 25-30, have been deported from the US after attempting the perilous 'dunki' route. One individual recounted selling farmland for Rs 57 lakh to an agent, only to be jailed for 14 months and deported.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Kai Cenat goes viral freestyling with random local on the streets of Spain
item.description: Streamer Kai Cenat was recently seen freestyling with a local on the streets of Spain, creating a viral moment. Clips show him engaging in a lively rap session, even attempting Spanish, which amused onlookers and fans alike. This spontaneous encounter highlighted his ability to entertain anywhere, turning a casual street moment into a cultural crossover.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Mehdi Hasan trolls Elon Musk over Zohran Mamdani remark: ‘Worst person you know just made a great point’
item.description: Elon Musk's praise for New York mayoral candidate Zohran Mamdani, calling him "the future of the Democratic Party," sparked a viral reaction. Journalist Mehdi Hasan humorously agreed with Musk's point, highlighting a rift within the Democratic Party over Mamdani's socialist agenda. The endorsement comes as the New York mayoral race intensifies.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Who is Ben Bader’s girlfriend Reem? TikTok star’s emotional last call before his sudden death at 25
item.description: Beloved TikTok creator Ben Bader, known for his positive messages, passed away unexpectedly at 25. His girlfriend, Reem, confirmed his death, sharing their last loving conversation hours before. Fans are mourning the loss of the young influencer, whose final video encouraged kindness. The cause of death remains unconfirmed, with Reem urging against speculation.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Ben Bader cause of death: How did the Miami TikTok star die at 25
item.description: Miami-based TikTok and Instagram creator Ben Bader, known for his positive lifestyle and fitness content, died unexpectedly on October 23, 2025, at the age of 25. His girlfriend confirmed the news, stating his death was a shock as he appeared healthy and happy just hours prior. The official cause of death remains unconfirmed, with his family urging against speculation.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: UK–Turkey Eurofighters deal: $10.7 billion pact for 20 jets sealed
item.description: Turkey and the UK have finalized an £8 billion deal for 20 Eurofighter Typhoon jets, marking a significant boost to bilateral defense ties and NATO security. This landmark agreement, signed during UK PM Keir Starmer's visit, also includes an option for future sales, strengthening Turkey's air force as it awaits its indigenous KAAN fighter.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Pakistani man kills estranged Indian-origin wife with cyanide-like powder in New York as she was seeking divorce
item.description: An Indian-origin woman, Aleena Asif, was tragically killed in her Long Island reidence by her estranged husband, Asif Qureshi, who attacked her with a chemical substance after stalking her. Qureshi, who pleaded not guilty, had a history of domestic incidents. The couple shared three children, and Aleena had previously sought law enforcement's help due to threats.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
